svg.desc: What this figure shows: Qm14 Hilbert Space Dimension. Visible guideposts include: 0; 5; 10; 15; 20; 25; 30. How to read it: use the explicitly printed labels, arrows, axes, panels, regions, and legends; do not assign meaning from color, proximity, or shape unless the figure says so.
